questions: Which existing methods are closest to training-time, context-subgraph-enriched supervision for multi-hop KGQA — subgraph retrieval/knowledge-augmented pretraining/graph-neural KGQA — and how much do they overlap?

Does the idea already exist under other terminology (subgraph-aware or neighborhood-aware KG embedding training, knowledge-graph-augmented LLM pretraining, contextualized fact supervision, query subgraph retrieval, intermediate/path supervision)?

Is the mechanism feasible: do standard multi-hop KGQA benchmarks (MetaQA, WebQSP, CWQ, HotpotQA) provide source-passage provenance linking triples to a shared passage, and if not, which text-grounded KGs do?
What is the correct baseline and evaluation methodology (datasets, KG versions, splits, Hits@1 vs EM/F1, hop-depth transfer protocol) that a controlled comparison must follow?
Does any accuracy gain from context enrichment survive matched controls for number of examples, supervision tokens, and template?
Does an adaptive one-hop-failure repair loop genuinely reduce base-fact errors, or does it amplify label noise / reward-hack the failure detector?
Does RL-based optimization on lower-hop instances transfer to deeper-hop queries, or overfit shallow path patterns?
search_topics: subgraph-aware / neighborhood-aware knowledge graph embedding training (R-GCN, CompGCN, NBFNet)
knowledge-graph-augmented language model pretraining and injection (ERNIE, K-BERT, KnowBert, KEPLER, KG-BERT, continual pretraining vs GraphRAG)
subgraph retrieval-augmented generation over KGs (DrKGC, GRAG, GNN-RAG, SG-RAG, Think-on-Graph, ToG-2)
query-subgraph / path-based multi-hop KGQA (EmbedKGQA, NSM/intermediate supervision, UniKGQA, QAGNN)
rejection sampling / self-training / iterative self-refinement / error-driven data augmentation (Self-Refine, STaR)
reinforcement learning for KGQA and multi-hop reasoning (DeepPath, MINERVA reward shaping, KG-Hopper, KG-Reasoner, GRPO-style objectives)
hop-length generalization / transfer in multi-hop reasoning and chain-of-thought
noise and incompleteness in knowledge graphs and robustness of KGQA to incorrect base facts
text-grounded knowledge graphs with passage provenance (HotpotQA supporting paragraphs, text-derived/temporal KGs)
comparison_targets: EmbedKGQA (Saxena et al. 2020) - embedding-based multi-hop KGQA
NSM / intermediate supervision (He et al. 2021) - path supervision for KGQA
GNN-RAG (Mavromatis & Karypis 2025) - graph-neural retrieval for LLM KG reasoning
DrKGC (Xiao et al. 2025) - dynamic subgraph retrieval-augmented LLM for KG completion
GRAG (Hu et al. 2025) - graph retrieval-augmented generation
SG-RAG MOT (Saleh et al. 2025) - subgraph retrieval with merging/ordering of triplets
KG-Hopper / KG-Reasoner (Wang & Yu 2026) - RL for LLM KG reasoning
DeepPath (Xiong et al. 2017) and MINERVA/reward shaping (Das et al. 2018; Lin et al. 2018) - RL path reasoning
KagNet (Feng et al. 2020) - knowledge-aware QA over paths
KG-augmented LM pretraining baselines (ERNIE, K-BERT, KnowBert, KEPLER)
isolated-triple fine-tuning baseline (plain triple serialization, no context)
